title: The Copper Harbor
author: Yara Galloway
blurb: Sable Montrose, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
